batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b YK Pathan

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b BA Bhatt

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b BA Bhatt

balls.text: full ball outside off to end the innings, 148kmh, batsman was backing away, he can't reach the ball and Punjab end on 119
hit to long-off, they take the single after Praveen muscled the ball past the bowler, there is an extra run after that with an overthrow

one more run out? moves towards leg and carves the ball towards cover, throw fired in to the keeper, who is a yard away from the stumps, he throws the ball onto the stumps and Karthik is gone, perhaps he might have made his ground if he dived, smartly done by Shreevats
they can, it was a length ball on offstump, Karthik moved across to whip the ball behind square leg, past the fielder for four
slow bouncer from Lee, 114kmh, pulled towards deep midwicket, one-bounce to the fielder
looks to whack the ball towards midwicket, full ball, weak hit towards midwicket
Balaji keeps it full, Karthik looks to muscle the ball down the ground, doesn't get the power on it., ball rolls to long-on
skips away from leg, another yorker, this time outside off, chopped towards cover
a 124.5 kmh yorker from Balaji, spot on from the bowler, Karthik digs it out, on to the pads and stop dead, batsmen zip through for a single
full and outside off, just a single, towards extra cover
flatbatted down the ground, not too well timed, and Punjab just can't find the boundaries, they take on Morgan and manage to sneak the second
shortish on legstump, whipped down to fine leg
a 145kmh ball to end the over, shortish and over middle stump, Bipul wanted to chop that through cover, ball sails over his bat
fuller ball, flicked to fine leg by Karthik
short of length ball outside leg, batsman skips away from leg and pokes the ball towards point
worked to deep midwicket for a single

Lee is convinced he has Karthik caught behind, umpire isn't, a short ball that Karthik moved across and wanted to help along to fine leg, Lee was certain he has the batsman dismissed before he turns to see that the umpire is unmoved, replays show it flew off the glove to the keeper
wants to wallop the first ball of Lee's spell, mistimed towards mid-on

superbly fielded by Pathan at long-on, a short of length ball is powerfully flat-batted down the ground, looked like heading for a four before Pathan stuck his hand out after zipping across from long-on
full and wide, stabbed to backward point, can't beat the fielder, no footwork at all from the batsman
a slow bouncer from Balaji, Karthik wants to pull that hard, but gets it on the glove towards square leg
slapped off the back foot towards point for a single
a very slow delivery from Balaji, 102kmh, Bipul waits for it and guides it behind backward point, appeal for a run out but Bipul is safe
Balaji starts with a shortish ball on legstump, pulled to deep backward square leg
Bipul plays the sweep, just about gets bat on it and gets it very fine past the keeper, who is standing up, the umpire initially signalled wides then changed the decision to runs
keeps it full, on legstump, Karthik wanted to whip that to the leg side, edges it towards Morgan at backward point
absolutely no pace from Bhatia, he's been bowling at a spinner's pace this over, 96 kmh this time, full and guided to fine leg
fullish ball on middle, glanced towards fine leg for a single
another dot ball, blocked to the leg side this time
defends the first ball

another big lbw appeal, this time the umpire is convinced, the big wicket of Hussey for Abdulla, he's having a great season, this was fired in quick, Hussey looking for the spin but there isn't no extravagant turn, slips past the bat and on to the pad, was that doing enough to take legstump? I'm not sure it was, the umpire does though
an lbw appeal from Kolkata is turned down, pitching on middle and turning sharply, hits him on the thigh on the back leg, that was going to miss off
reverse-sweep from Karthik, gets it towards backward point
tucked to midwicket for a single
a rare misfield from Kolkata, Gambhir is not happy at that, gives the fielder the teapot, pushed towards backward point, the ball spins behind Bhatia as he looks to field and it goes away for four
more forward defence from Hussey
blocked to the off side to end the over
a near yorker on middle and leg, blocked back to the bowler
full ball around off, Karthik squeezes it towards backward point
punched off the front foot towards extra cover

oh dear, Bhatia fumes as there are four overthrows, it was a full toss on middle stump, reverse-swept towards point where Morgan is quickly on to the ball, he fires it in at the non-striker's end, hits Karthik's bat and goes away for overthrows, Karthik sportingly decided against running the overthrows but the ball races over the ropes, which means Punjab get the runs
fullish ball on middle, more cautiously nudging of the ball
fullish from Pathan outside off, whipped towards wide mid-on
gets on one knee and sweeps hard towards deep square leg
blocked towards the leg side from the crease
on middle and leg stump, tucked towards square leg, Kolkata's slow bowlers doing a fantastic job here
another call of 'Catch' as the ball is whipped just wide of the midwicket fielder
this one keeps low, outside off and it  slips under the bat, takes the keeper by surprise as well, dribbles after hitting the keeper's glove
slapped off the back foot to cover, too firmly hit for a single
more luck for Hussey, ball hits his pads outside leg and goes to the keeper and that is called wide
why was that not out? pitching on leg, jags back and hits the back pad in front of middle and leg, he  was a goner, umpire perhaps thought that pitched outside leg, lucky Hussey

oh my, what is with Punjab's running today? Hussey pushes the ball towards extra cover, shouts 'Wait, wait', Karthik was dashing off, had to scramble back and he would have been safe even if there was a direct hit
sharp fielding from Morgan, just outside off, chopped towards backward point
played with the turn again, nudged toward short fine
a typical wristy hit from Hussey sends that fullish ball scurrying in front of square leg
keeper appeals loudly though that was way down the leg side and nowhere near the bat
driven along the ground towards long-off by Karthik for a single
Karthik gets a big stride in as he defends to the off side
even Tiwary is getting the ball to turn here, edged towards the leg side
a low full toss, smartly put away,  driven inside-out past extra cover for four
length ball to end a tight over, Hussey gets forward and eases the ball to short cover
just outside off, Karthik opens the face and dabs the ball towards backward point for a single, that was a legcutter from Bhatia
pushed towards long-on to get off the mark

another run-out, terrible cricket this from Punjab, a defensive push from Karthik towards point, Morgan swoops on to that and the throw is a tough high for the keeper, who takes off the bails even as Nayar puts in a dive, thats not enough for Nayar, and things getting bad to worse for Punjab, the Edeh Gardens crowd are enjoyed the Saturday night
Bhatia begins with a length ball on off, defended off the front foot by Karthik
ooh, Pathan bowls that from round the wicket, gets the leading edge and the ball nearly pops back to the bowler
worked to backward square leg for a single
turns in and past the pads, nudged deftly and fine for four to fine leg, that shot brings up the Punjab fifty
cautiously defended by Karthik off the front foot
attempts the reverse-sweep this time, the ball lobs up to the keeper, a loud appeal but the umpire correctly rules that it came off the forearm guard
nicely done by Karthik, he has decided the way to deal with the spinners it to sweep, gets well forward and powerfully sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary
a massive appeal for a catch at leg slip, umpire is unmoved as that came off the pad as the batsman looked to defend

bowled him, Abdulla is elated and sets off a celebratory run, not exactly his greatest delivery but he doesn't care, it was a slightly short ball, Gilchrist shaped to mow that to the leg side, but it skids on and he misses the ball and is nutmegged, through his leg and on to the stumps, Dav Whatmore pumps his fists in the dug out
another sweep from Karthik, from outside off, a bit of a top-edge as it lobs to short fine leg
this time Gilchrist goes for it, doesn't quite time it, it reaches long-on on the bounce
overpitched and outside off , blocked by Gilchrist from the crease
gets well forward and sweeps it for a single
outside off and gilchrist lets it go, hits the keeper's pads, but Kolkata still appeal for an lbw

oh dear, plenty more mails will come in for Shakib's inclusion after this ball, flighted and slants in as Yusuf bowls from round the wicket, takes off from a length and turns sharply away as well, Gilchrist can't get bat on that
length ball outside off, punched towards ten Doeschate at point, smartly fielded
tucked towards square leg for an ambled single
flatter delivery outside off, Karthik blocks it
on the pads, defended to the leg side, this time Karthik sets out of the crease, Gilchrist stays firmly put

disaster for Punjab, Marsh is gone, that wasn't great running from them, Abdulla fired the ball in from round the wicket, struck the pads, prompting a big appeal, Marsh was seeing the ball as it bobbled square on the off side, Gilchrist  was already halfway down when Marsh looks up to see him charging, he puts his hand out to ask Gilchrist to stop but it is too late, Marsj has no chance at all to make it to the non-striker's end
just outside off, blocked from the crease to the off side
punched past a diving Abdulla to the long-off boundary, Marsh gets a big stride in as he drives that one
overpitched outside off, defended off the front foot towards the off side
finding it tough to play the spinners, Gilchrist hits this uppishly to the left of the bowler
Abdulla appeals for a lbw after the ball pitches on middle and off and turns sharply in, that hit high on the pad and was going down
chopped towards point to end the over
spins past the outside edge, starts outside off and turns away
down the leg side, keeper can't collect
on the pads, tucked towards short fine by Marsh

Valthaty is gone, he hasn't had much strike so far, he spies a slightly short one, Valthaty takes on the fielder at long-on, the flat-batted hit doesn't have enough power behind it, it sails only as far as Manoj Tiwary
'Catch it,' Yusuf screams as Valthaty plays a lofted inside-out shot which just clears cover, Yusuf has his hands on his head
shortish ball outside off, pulled towards deep midwicket by Gilchrist
jabs this one towards cover
lovely ball from Abdulla, tosses up his first ball to Valthaty, pitching on off and turns past the outside edge
length ball outside off, off the bat and on to the pads as Gilchrist defends
shortish from Abdulla, on middle and leg, Gilchrist moves across and swipes that over short fine for four, superb shot from Gilly
on the pads this time, Gilchrist taps this one towards square leg
fullish and outside off, defended to the leg side off the back foot
length ball outside off, Valthaty wants to power the ball through the off, inside-edged towards short fine leg
short of length ball on middle and off, defended watchfully from the crease
short once more, sits up for Gilchrist, who is content to help it along to deep backward square leg
bangs in the bouncer, but is down the leg side
pitching on middle and slanting towards leg, a hit-me ball, whacked by Gilchrist to the midwicket boundary
cranking up the pace now Lee, 147kmh, pitches it up, Gilchrist plays that from the crease, screams 'NO' after pushing it towards extra cover
a classic Gilchrist shot to bring up the first six of the match, a length ball just outside off, slammed over long-on by Gilchrist
slides it on to leg, whipped towards midwicket by Valthaty
well outside off from Balaji, Gilchrist doesn't try to power this one, just glides it towards fine leg
length ball, swings in towards middle and leg, squeezed towards extra cover
closer to off than the first ball of the over, Gilchrist looked to scythe that through point again, he misses
superb slower on from Balaji, 112kmh, Gilchrist was shaping for the pull seeing the ball pitched short, took an eternity to reach the batsman, who opts against the stroke
his first ball is a bit wide, that's enough for Gilchrist, who has been great on the cut through his career, slashes this one past point for four
on legstump to end the over, guided towards backward square leg by Gilchrist, good start from Lee

Valthaty starts nervously, an inside-edge as he looks push the ball to the off side, jags back in a touch, the ball dribbles towards backward square leg, keeper runs across to field, Gilchrist was three-fourths through the run before Valthaty responds, Valthaty gets in the way of the throw and the stumps and makes his ground
First run for Punjab and Gilchrist, tapped off the backfoot towards mid-off and races through for the single
142.6 this time, slightly shorter, slapped towards covers, 'No, no' calls Gilchrist after playing that
a 139.4kmh ball follows, again tight around off, eased towards mid-off this time
Lee starts with a length ball on off, pushed towards extra cover

Korbo, lorbo, jetbo and all that, all too easy for Kolkata, on the pads, tucked behind square for the winning run, Kolkata go top of the table! superb stand between Gambhir and Tiwary flattens them after the spinners did the job early on,
scores are level, Gambhir heaves the length ball over wide long-on for four
jabbed to backward point, another dot ball to end
Tiwary wanted to slam that against the spin and into the crowd, can't connect
swiped towards deep midwicket this time for a single
Gambhir waltzes out of the crease and whips the ball,can't beat Hussey at midwicket again
full ball on off, can't beat the man at midwicket
another sweep from Tiwary, to square leg to move Kolkata within six of the target
full and outside off, swept along the ground behind square leg
turns past the leg  stump, Punjab have given away nearly 10% of the target in wides
charges out once more, but can't get under this one, slammed towards cover
Tiwary muscles this one over long-off for a big six, and the crowd loves it, that was a big hit, Tiwary comes out of the crease to reach the pitch of the ball
another googly, this time it gets the leading edge, which lands safely short of cover
googly hits the footmarks and bounces and turns, Gambhir is beaten
full and into the pads, worked to fine leg, Gambhir sprints through for the second
looks to muscle the ball out of the ground, mistimes it and the ball reaches mid-on on the bounce
guided down towards fine leg for a single
nearly sneaks past the bat that one, Gambhir was looking to defend off the front foot, gets an inside-edge on to the pad
turns into Tiwary, who tucks the ball to midwicket
a single to cover brings up the century, 20 to go
shortish ball outside off, Gambhir slashes it behind point for a boundary, beating the diving fielder in the deep
the final delivery is defended off the back foot to the bowler
turns in sharply, Gambhir adjust well, he was initially looking for an expansive shot, check it to carve the ball to cover
guided off the back foot towards point
loopy ball pitching well outside off, looks to sweep that one, doesn't get bat on it
defended off the front foot towards point
wide outside off
dabbed to point
batsman gets forward and punches the ball towards cover
bowling at a Rajat Bhatia pace, guided towards backward point
driven to cover off the front foot
lovely work from Tiwary, he's in superb form, another attempted slower ball, Tiwary opens the face and guides it fine past the keeper for four
short ball, slower one from Valthaty, that kept low, on legstump, worked in front of square leg
slow delivery outside off, defended towards point off the front foot
eased to long-on for a single to end the over, this has been a cruise for Kolkata
dabbed to point, Tiwary wanted one, Gambhir didn't
pitching outside off and turning in, played form the crease towards cover
spins it down the leg side
takes an age to arrive to the batsman, short ball that turns away, Tiwary plays it off the back foot, against the turn towards wide mid-on
loopy delivery, pitches outside off and turns further away, beats Tiwary
spin it into the pads, tucked to square leg
shortish ball just outside off, defended to the leg side
on legstump once more, off the gloves of Gambhir towards short fine
shortish ball pitching on leg and jagging down, Gilchrist dives but he can't get to it as the late movement beats him
short of a length and outside off, tips it to the off side and scoots through for a single
shortish ball on the pads, Gambhir jumps and guides the ball towards short fine leg
on the pads, whipped towards midwicket
Harris returns, starts with a length ball heading for middle, Tiwary plays it to mid-on, Gambhir wants a single, Tiwary doesn't, Gambhir races back, would have been tight if there was a direct hit
guided towards point for a sharp single
drilled down to long-off for a single
innovative from Gambhir, stretches forwards and plays the ball fine past the keeper down the leg side
stabs it towards point
too full from the bowler, driven crisply past extra cover, poor fielding in the deep, Chawla should have stopped that but his dive is ineffective
short of length and outside off, dabbed behind point
flighted and and outside off, driven square for a single
spots the googly early, backs away and carves the ball to sweeper cover
short of length ball on the pads, Gambhir charges out but can only punch it back to the bowler
eased towards extra cover for a single
tried to paddle that one from outside off, gets it on the toe end of the bat, just wide of the keeper to the leg side
runs it towards short third man
shortish and outside off, Gambhir slaps it towards cover
on the pads, tucked behind square leg
this time he tosses it up, driven towards mid-off
carved towards sweeper cover for a single
not much flight from Hussey, jabbed towards point
defends the length ball towards cover
this time the googly spins too much for Gambhir, he's beaten outside off as he looks to drive
fired in quicker, defended to square leg
Gambhir is a great player of spin, he shows it here, charging out and getting to the pitch and then whipping it to wide long-on for four
length ball, the googly makes its appearance, Gambhir jabs it off the back foot
fullish ball outside off, swept firmly towards deep backward square leg
tossed up and fullish one, driven towards mid-on
spins the first one down the leg side
keeps it short of length and outside off, guided to backward point by Tiwary
extra bounce for Harris, Tiwary wanted to guide that to third man but can't connect
shorter this time, outside off, tapped towards backward point
lovely hit from Tiwary, length ball outside off, confidently strides out and drives that through point for four
tapped towards cover off the front foot
short of length on legstump, off the thigh pad towards square leg
nudged to midwicket for a single
poor ball from Bhargav, pitches outside leg and turn further away, Gambhir just had to lap it past short fine leg to pick up a boundary, quite easily done
Gambhir comes down the track to clip the ball to midwicket, can't connect struck on the pads
eased back to the bowler

superb catch from Ryan Harris ends Morgan's cameo, an effortless chip shot from Morgan towards deep midwicket, Harris charges in from the deep and takes the ball low as it was dipping on him, Punjab need more of these if they are to make a fight of it
outside leg stump, tucked behind square leg
hammered by Morgan for another boundary, it was short and outside off, Morgan rocks back and clubs it over mid-on for four
providing plenty of width in this over, chopped towards point
a low full toss outside off, muscled towards extra cover, can't beat the fielder
Morgan is in a hurry here, another boundary for him, scythed over cover off the front foot for four more
plenty of flight from Hussey and that nearly got the wicket, a top edge loops towards point, lands safely between two fielders and then speeds away to the boundary
Hussey starts round the wicket, well outside off, dabbed towards backward point
short of length and outside off, Morgan goes for the cut again, misses as the ball sneaks under the bat
short of length and just outside off, dabbed towards point
short and wide, Punjab can't afford these, Morgan thrashes it over cover for four
the bottom hand comes off as Morgan slams that one over mid-on, inside half off the bat, lands a few yards inside the rope
cut away towards point by Morgan
batsman skips away past leg and looks to cut the ball, edges it towards third man
confusion in the middle, Gambhir is sprinting for the single, Morgan doesn't want one after he plays the ball towards short fine, Gambhir makes a mad dash back
whipped uppishly off the pads, towards midwicket
full ball is driven towards deep midwicket, sharp running gets them three
flighted again, overpitched on legstump, tucked behind square leg
flighted and full on legstump, defended to the leg side
Bharghav Bhatt has got  big wicket, he makes the first one turn a long way, Kallis is surprised by that, and checks his shot, ball loops to cover for an overhead catch, Punjab fight
skates down the track and slaps the ball towards point
Praveen always gets the ball to nip around early, this game is no different, moves away from Morgan and beats the outside edge
what shot from Morgan, shortish outside off and caressed to the deep backward point off the back foot, supreme timing that
ooh, that one came on sharply, whipped towards midwicket by Kallis, that one came in a long way
shorter this time, and curves a bit away, defended off the back foot
starts with a length ball that jags in , Kallis moves across and defends to the leg side
